messages:
maria: FYI, rollback not ideal. Proxy change lowercased `X-RD-RoutePolicy` -> `x-rd-routepolicy` and TS client sanitizer is strict so hints dropped.
aj: ugh. seeing Dedicated fallbacks too. which SDKs affected? py/ts/go?
sasha: TS and Py primarily. Go uses net/http canonicalization so it was tolerating it until a recent liberalization of header keys introduced by the proxy.
kevin: console alert: fallback rate +22% for a handful of tenants after the canary push at 09:10.
devex: can we ship a non-breaking client shim today? sounds like a quick win.
ryan: telemetry pipeline can also normalize on ingest. risk: split metrics across multiple header keys until backfilled.
aj: plan: quick TS+Py patch to accept both header casings and emit a diagnostic telemetry tag `routehdr_compat=dual`. add unit/regression tests. publish canary to npm/pypi.
sasha: console side: adjust dashboard ingest to canonicalize route key to `x-rd-route-policy` and collapse old keys via backfill job. I'll add a feature flag to flip normalization once patches are live.
kevin: ops: throttled backfill to 3k ev/s. infra-bot: can you confirm deploy permissions for telemetry config?
infra-bot: deploy-window check: small telemetry config changes allowed in critical patch window 10:30 UTC. Non-critical infra changes at 18:00 UTC.
maria: timeline: can we have SDK canaries + telemetry flag behind feature flag by 10:00? office demo at 11:00 — need mitigation before then.
aj: starting TS patch. estimate 45m incl tests & canary publish.
ryan: I'll implement ingestion normalizer behind FF and create backfill job; will hold flip until TS/py canaries look good for 15m.
sasha: console dash mapping will be resilient to both keys; also add a note in rollout docs about header canonicalization.
kevin: create incident stub in incidents channel, tag SRE for monitoring. if anything spikes, we can temporarily route-to-old-proxy.
devex: good call. add a short blurb to SDK release notes so customers know why we accept both casings for a while.
maria: summary of actions: aj -> TS/Py shim + telemetry tag; ryan -> ingestion normalizer + FF + backfill; sasha -> console mapping + doc; kevin -> monitoring + incident stub. aim to close by 10:50. update here when each step completes. :thumbsup:
